label: Bible Study
prompt: He that spareth his _____ hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verse: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
note: An old line on discipline — the point is love that bothers to correct.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And they said one to another, Did not our heart _____ within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verse: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
note: Two disciples on the Emmaus road realize why their hearts burned as the stranger talked — it was Jesus.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And if a house be _____ against itself, that house cannot stand.
verse: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
note: Lincoln borrowed it in 1858; Jesus first said it to critics who claimed he cast out devils by the devil's power.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for _____?
verse: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
note: Satan's question: does Job serve God only because God pays well? The whole book answers it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask _____, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
verse: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
note: Unanswered prayer, diagnosed: ye ask 'amiss' — wrongly — to spend it on your own lusts.
